Runbooks you can run with run_runbook (read one with load_runbook):
- bring_up: After the controller has been powered on, or whenever the arm is not enabled and homed.
- calibration_validity: When a grasp misses by a constant amount, after an instrument or base frame change, or when asked whether the calibration is valid.
- return_to_start: At the end of a trial, after a failed grasp, or whenever the arm should be put back where a trial begins.
- rig_check: Before every trial, and after anything on the rig has been touched. It moves nothing.
- verify_grasp_retention: When the open jaw is at the grasp pose over the needle and the needle has to be shown to be held before it is carried anywhere.
